papers.title_en: A clinical-radiomics model based on MRI sub-regions of gluteus maximus for recurrence prediction in high-grade serous ovarian cancer
papers.tldr: 高级别浆液性卵巢癌复发风险预测对个体化治疗至关重要。现有影像组学多聚焦肿瘤本身，忽略了臀大肌等身体成分的潜在价值。本研究提出基于磁共振成像臀大肌子区域的临床-影像组学模型，自动分割多个子区域并提取影像特征，结合临床指标构建预测模型。实验显示该模型预测复发性能优于传统影像组学和深度学习方法，为精准预后评估提供了新工具。
papers.abstract_en: Purpose To evaluate the predictive value of MRI sub-regional radiomics of thegluteus maximus for recurrence in high-grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC) andcompare its performance with conventional radiomics and deep learning (DL) …

papers.title_en: A Survey on Post-Training of Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.tldr: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的快速发展深刻影响了AI领域，使其能更好地理解和交互。后训练是提升模型性能的关键阶段，但相关技术缺乏系统梳理。本文全面综述MLLM后训练技术，涵盖数据构建、对齐策略、指令微调与偏好优化等方法，并讨论评估基准与开放挑战，为后续研究提供结构化参考。
papers.abstract_en: The technical evolution of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) hasprofoundly influenced the AI community, reshaping how intelligent systemsunderstand, reason, and interact in both the digital and physical worlds. Through …

papers.title_en: CLEAR-WSI: Towards Foundation Model Empowered Diagnosis Aligned Whole Slide Image Retrieval
papers.tldr: 数字病理学中H&E染色的全切片图像（WSI）大量增长，但缺乏结构化索引和可靠元数据，导致系统性检索困难。为此提出CLEAR-WSI，利用基础模型实现与诊断对齐的WSI检索，通过将病理图像与诊断语义对齐来提升检索准确性和可解释性。该工作为海量未标注病理数据的利用提供了新思路，具有重要的临床和科研价值。
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of digital pathology has produced vast repositories of hematoxylinand eosin (H\&E) stained whole-slide images (WSIs). However, many of thesearchives lack structured indexing and reliable metadata, making systematic …

papers.title_en: Clinical Reliability and Failure-Risk Analysis of Deep Learning–Based Postoperative Glioblastoma Segmentation for Radiotherapy: A Multi-Metric Evaluation Using …
papers.tldr: 深度学习自动分割有望优化胶质母细胞瘤放疗计划，但安全临床集成需兼顾精度与可靠性。本研究对术后胶质母细胞瘤分割开展多指标评估，系统分析临床可靠性与失败风险。结果显示模型在异构数据上表现稳健，同时识别出关键失败模式。为临床转化提供了可靠性依据和风险警示。
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning–based automated segmentation has the potential to improveradiotherapy planning workflows for glioblastoma; however, safe clinical integrationrequires not only high accuracy but also reliable performance across heterogeneous …

papers.title_en: Debiased controllable text generation with classifier-guided rectified flow language model
papers.tldr: 可控文本生成常受训练数据中的虚假相关影响，导致生成结果带有偏见。本文提出基于分类器引导的rectified flow语言模型，通过纠偏流模型与分类器梯度引导实现可控且无偏的生成。实验表明，该方法在多个可控生成任务上优于基线，有效降低生成文本的偏见。贡献在于将rectified flow与分类器引导结合，为可控生成提供去偏新思路。

papers.title_en: Diagnostic Accuracy of APTw and NOEw MRI Metrics for IDH Mutation and 1p/19q Codeletion Prediction in Gliomas
papers.tldr: 胶质瘤分类依赖IDH突变和1p/19q共缺失等分子标志，但传统检测需侵入性活检。本研究评估APTw和NOEw MRI指标对这两类分子状态的诊断准确性。结果表明相关MRI指标能有效预测IDH突变和1p/19q状态，提供无创诊断途径，对术前预后分层和治疗决策具有临床价值。
papers.abstract_en: Isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) mutation and 1p/19q codeletion are key molecularmarkers for glioma classification. Amide proton transfer weighted (APTw) andnuclear Overhauser effect–weighted (NOEw) markers showed promise for glioma …

papers.title_en: Dynamic Spectral Calibration Integrated with Diffusion Based Temporal Fusion for Accurate and Interpretable Hyperspectral Brain Tumor Segmentation
papers.tldr: 脑肿瘤高光谱图像分割面临光谱漂移与噪声干扰，现有方法难以兼顾准确性与可解释性。本文提出动态光谱校准模块，自适应校正光谱变异，并结合基于扩散模型的时间融合策略，聚合多时刻信息以增强特征稳定性。在公开数据集上的实验表明，该方法分割精度优于现有技术，同时通过校准过程提升了模型的可解释性。
papers.abstract_en: The segmentation of brain tumors, based on hyperspectral imaging (HSI), has beenattracting considerable interest for its capability of providing detailed spectral–spatialinformation about tissue. Current segmentation methods based on HSI have …

papers.title_en: External validation of a top-ranked model from the RSNA pulmonary embolism detection challenge: assessment of generalizability
papers.tldr: 肺栓塞(PE)是常见急症，CTPA是其诊断金标准。RSNA 2020挑战赛涌现出高性能深度学习算法，但需验证其外部泛化性。本文对挑战赛亚军算法进行外部验证，除整体PE检测外，特别关注亚段-only PE这一易漏诊亚型。结果显示算法在外部数据集上保持了较好性能，但亚段-only PE的敏感性有待提高，提示需针对性优化。
papers.abstract_en: To externally validate the RSNA 2020 challenge 2nd-place deep-learning (DL)algorithm for detecting pulmonary embolism (PE) on computed tomographypulmonary angiography (CTPA) scans with additional focus on subsegmental-only …

papers.title_en: Lightweight Deep Learning Models for Lung Disease Classification Using Chest X-ray Images
papers.tldr: 肺病分类对于快速自动化医疗诊断具有重要意义，但现有深度学习模型通常需要高昂的计算成本。针对这一问题，本文提出了专门用于胸片图像分类的轻量级深度学习模型，通过设计高效的网络结构来减少参数量和运算开销。实验结果显示，该模型在分类性能上接近甚至优于原始模型，同时大幅降低了部署门槛。此项工作为资源受限环境下的肺病筛查提供了一种高效且经济的解决方案，有助推动AI医学影像的普及应用。
papers.abstract_en: Lung disease classification from chest X-ray images using deep learning hasattracted significant attention due to its potential to support rapid and automatedmedical diagnosis. However, many deep learning models require high …

papers.title_en: Mechanical Thrombectomy in Ischemic Stroke With a Medium or Distal Arterial Occlusion: The DISCOUNT Randomized Clinical Trial
papers.tldr: 急性缺血性卒中（AIS）中，中等或远端血管闭塞（MDVO）的机械取栓治疗证据不足。DISCOUNT随机临床试验旨在评估在标准药物治疗基础上，加用机械取栓是否带来额外获益。该试验将提供高等级证据，为MDVO患者的治疗选择提供依据，并评估疗效与安全性。
papers.abstract_en: Importance Evidence regarding efficacy and safety of thrombectomy in acuteischemic stroke (AIS) due to medium or distal vessel occlusions (MDVOs) is lacking.Objective To evaluate the benefit of thrombectomy, in addition to medical treatment …

papers.title_en: Open 3D-CT Vision-Language Models Do Not Clear a Pre-Registered Biomarker Gate Under Zero-Shot Prompting at n= 96 NSCLC-Radiogenomics
papers.tldr: 针对小样本放射基因组学预测，开源3D-CT视觉语言模型（VLM）提出了一种零样本生物标志物评分的可能路径，无需目标数据标注训练。然而，在96例NSCLC-Radiogenomics数据集的预先注册评估中，模型在零样本提示下未能通过预设的生物标志物性能门槛。这说明当前图像-文本对齐的迁移能力有限，不能直接替代有监督训练。这一阴性结果警示：此类模型需经严格基准测试和适配后，方可考虑用于临床研究。
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Background. Recent open 3D-CT vision-language models (VLMs) offer amethodological possibility for very-small-cohort radiogenomic prediction: zeroshotbiomarker scoring via image-text alignment, with no labelled training on the target …

papers.title_en: PVRSAP-Net: Probabilistic Voxel Refinement and Spatial Attention Pyramid Learning for Three-Dimensional Multiregion Brain Tumor Segmentation
papers.tldr: 针对多模态MRI中脑胶质瘤亚区域分割面临的边缘模糊、病灶体积小、跨受试者强度差异及粗标注等问题，提出PVRSAP-Net。该方法结合概率体素细化与空间注意力金字塔学习，实现三维多区域肿瘤的精确分割。实验验证其在多个指标上优于现有方法，有效提升弱边缘和小病灶的分割精度。
papers.abstract_en: Accurate three-dimensional delineation of glioma subregions from multimodalmagnetic resonance imaging remains difficult when tumor margins are weak, lesionvolumes are small, acquisition intensity varies across subjects, or a coarse …

papers.title_en: Whole-esophageal radiomics and deep learning for predicting the pT and pN categories of resectable esophageal cancer
papers.tldr: 食管癌术前准确评估pT和pN分期对治疗决策至关重要。本研究从增强动脉期CT图像提取全食管影像组学与深度学习特征，并结合临床数据构建预测模型。结果显示该模型能有效区分pT和pN类别，为可切除食管癌提供无创分期工具，具有临床辅助决策潜力。
papers.abstract_en: To investigate the application of whole-esophageal radiomics and deep learningfeatures derived from enhanced arterial phase CT images along with clinical data todifferentiate the pT and pN categories in patients with resectable esophageal cancer …

papers.title_en: Z-Adapter: Parameter-Efficient 2.5 DLongitudinal Fusion for SAM2-Based Lung Tumor Segmentation in CT
papers.tldr: 提示性基础模型加速了医学图像分割，但直接在CT上逐切片应用2D模型常导致纵向闪烁，即相邻切片间肿瘤掩膜不稳定，影响体积测量。本文提出Z-Adapter，一种参数高效的2.5D纵向融合模块，用于基于SAM2的肺肿瘤分割，通过融合相邻切片信息来稳定分割结果，减少闪烁并提升测量准确性。
papers.abstract_en: Promptable foundation models have accelerated medical image segmentation, yetnaïvely applying 2D models slice-by-slice on CT often yields longitudinal flicker:unstable tumor masks across adjacent slices that degrade volumetric measurements …

papers.title_en: Fine-Grained Vision-Language Pretraining with Organ-Conditioned Pattern Tokens for CT Understanding
papers.tldr: CT视觉-语言预训练通常采用全局扫描-报告对比，虽可扩展但掩盖了器官级异质性和局部语义。本文提出器官条件模式令牌，通过器官感知分解生成细粒度令牌，并与报告中的句子或短语进行细粒度对齐。在多项CT理解任务中，该方法优于全局对比基线，尤其提升器官定位和报告生成性能。这一工作为医学影像多模态预训练提供了结构先验和细粒度对齐的新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Computed tomography (CT) vision-language pretraining from paired volumes andradiology reports is a scalable yet challenging task. Existing methods commonlyadopt global scan-report contrast, which is scalable but obscures heterogeneous …

papers.title_en: MamaBench: Benchmarking LLM Robustness in Maternal and Child Health Diagnosis through Counterfactual Clinical Perturbation
papers.tldr: 尽管大语言模型在医学基准上取得高分，现有评测都将问题独立处理，无法评估模型能否区分临床相似但需要不同方案的病例。为此提出MamaBench，利用反事实临床扰动对妇幼健康诊断样本进行系统化改造，生成更具挑战的测试集。结果显示，模型在扰动后诊断一致性显著下降，暴露出对表面线索的过度依赖。MamaBench为医疗AI鲁棒性评估提供了新基准，并强调了在安全关键领域引入反事实测试的必要性。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models achieve strong scores on medical benchmarks, yet thesebenchmarks evaluate each question in isolation, providing no measure of whether asystem can distinguish clinically similar presentations requiring different …

papers.title_en: Region-Grounded Vision-Language Learning for Detection-Guided Mammographic Lesion Classification
papers.tldr: 视觉语言模型在医学图像中虽有前景，但全局图文对齐不适用于乳腺摄影，因为病灶具有空间局部性。本文提出区域级视觉语言学习，将图像区域与文本提示对齐，用于检测引导的乳腺病变分类。通过区域级对比学习提升模型对局部病变的判别能力。该方法在乳腺影像分类任务上展现出更好的性能与可解释性。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models trained with contrastive objectives have shown promise inmedical image analysis. However, conventional global image-text alignment is ill-suited for mammography, where diagnostically relevant lesions are spatially …

papers.title_en: Distilled Reinforcement Learning for LLM Post-training
papers.tldr: 大型语言模型后训练对推理与对齐至关重要。现有强化学习与在线策略蒸馏两种范式各有局限：前者依赖奖励模型且训练不稳定，后者受限于专家数据质量。本文提出蒸馏强化学习方法，将强化学习策略的更新过程化作蒸馏信号，指导学生模型高效学习，从而融合两范式优点。实验表明，该方法在推理与对齐任务上训练效率显著提升，性能可比或超越强化学习基线，且稳定性更强。该工作为后训练提供了高效稳定的新途径。

papers.title_en: From Data to Device: ELMOD An Efficient German-First 2.7 B Language Model for Mobile Inference
papers.tldr: 针对资源受限设备上大语言模型推理效率低的问题，提出面向德语优先场景的紧凑型2.7B参数模型ELMOD。在有限预算（约55k训练步）下训练，通过架构与部署优化实现移动端高效推理。在保证德语任务性能的同时显著降低计算开销，为边缘设备部署提供可行方案。
papers.abstract_en: We present ELMOD-Efficient Language Model for On-Device Deployment-a compact(2.7 B) German language model designed for efficient inference on resource-constrained hardware. ELMOD was trained on a limited computational budget (55k …

papers.title_en: Mage-VL: An Efficient Codec-Native Streaming Multimodal Foundation Model
papers.tldr: 现有视觉语言模型(VLM)存在莫拉维克悖论：复杂离线推理出色，但简单流式感知任务上表现差且计算冗余。Mage-VL以codec原生方式直接理解压缩码流，避免传统解码和视觉特征提取，实现高效流式多模态推理。在多个流式感知基准上达到最优性能，同时大幅降低延迟并提升吞吐。该工作为实时多模态感知提供了新的codec原生范式。
papers.abstract_en: Standard vision-language models (VLMs) suffer from Moravec's paradox: they excelat complex offline visual reasoning but struggle with simple streaming perceptiontasks and process them inefficiently. We present Mage-VL, an efficient codec-native …

papers.title_en: PerceptionBench: Evaluating Atomic Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.tldr: 现有的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）评估基准往往将感知与推理混合在一起进行评估，很难单独定位视觉感知层面的缺陷。为此，我们提出了PerceptionBench基准，专门用来评测原子视觉感知能力，包括颜色、形状、空间位置、数量等基本视觉属性，并设计了具有针对性的细粒度任务。在多种主流MLLM上的实验结果显示，这些模型在基础视觉属性上表现明显不佳，暴露出感知环节的显著短板。该基准填补了原子视觉感知评测的空白，为MLLM感知能力的系统诊断与改进提供了标准化平台。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce PerceptionBench, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate theatomic visual perception capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models(MLLMs). Existing benchmarks often fail to isolate perception: holistic evaluations …

papers.title_en: Would You Walk to the Car Wash? Revealing the Salience Bias of Large Language Models in Commonsense Reasoning
papers.tldr: 大语言模型在复杂推理中善于利用显式条件，但在日常常识推理中会过度关注表面信息而忽略隐含常识，产生显著性偏差。本文通过设计反事实场景测试，系统评估了模型在常识判断中的表现，发现模型常给出与常识相悖的结论。研究揭示了这一缺陷，并提醒在常识推理中需谨慎处理显式与隐含信息的关系。
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) continue to advance in complex reasoning tasks,they have learned to heavily prioritize explicit conditions provided in the input.However, in everyday commonsense reasoning, this mechanism exposes a critical …

papers.title_en: Location-Aware Fine-Grained Representation Learning for Medical Vision Foundation Models
papers.tldr: 医学图像中的诊断证据常微小且局部化，现有视觉基础模型难以捕捉细粒度特征。本文提出位置感知的细粒度表示学习方法，在transformer编码器中显式建模patch间的空间关联，强化可疑区域的特征表达。实验表明该方法在多个医学影像下游任务上优于基线，显著提升小病灶检测与分类性能。贡献在于为医学基础模型提供了一种通用的细粒度特征学习范式。
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained visual representations are essential for medical image analysis,particularly when diagnostically relevant evidence is subtle and spatially localized.Modern transformer-based medical vision encoders must therefore learn patch-level …

papers.title_en: CLIP-CC-Bench: Evaluating Paragraph-Level Video Descriptions in Video-Language Models
papers.tldr: 现有视频语言模型评测多聚焦于短片段和单句指标，缺乏对段落级长描述生成能力的系统评估，导致模型在真实场景下的描述质量未知。为此提出CLIP-CC-Bench基准，构建多样化视频数据集，设计严格的段落级描述评测指标，从准确性、完整性、连贯性等多维度衡量模型表现。在多个代表性视频语言模型上的实验表明，现有模型生成段落级描述时往往遗漏关键细节，并出现事实性错误，与人类标注差距明显。CLIP-CC-Bench填补了该评测空白，为未来长视频描述研究提供了标准化基准和参考。
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarking video-language models has largely focused on short clips and single-sentence metrics, leaving open whether current systems can generate accurate long-form, paragraph-level descriptions. We introduce CLIP-CC-Bench, an evaluation …
